capabilities: Save manual note versions with custom labels and descriptions
Auto-backup notes in the background while skipping identical content
Browse saved versions in a reverse-chronological timeline sidebar
Compare two versions side by side with word-level change highlights
Restore, export or delete individual versions
disambiguation: Not a Git client; it stores its own note snapshots in a hidden vault folder without commits or branches.
extras: Stores all version data in a hidden .metin-giti/ folder at the vault root; keeps up to 30 auto-backups per note and never deletes manual versions; interface available in English and Turkish.
intentEvidence: designed without technical Git concepts like commit, branch, or merge
problem: Obsidian keeps no per-note version history, and Git-based workflows force users to deal with commits, branches and merges.

relations.evidence: designed without technical Git concepts like commit, branch, or merge

summary: Version history and auto-backup for individual Markdown notes, with a timeline sidebar and side-by-side diffs.
